newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat, Mubarak talk Mideast peace at Egypt parade.
newsitem.headline: Arafat, Mubarak talk Mideast peace at Egypt parade.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in this northeastern Egyptian town on Monday to brief President Hosni Mubarak on a round of peace talks with Israel, diplomatic sources said.

Mubarak and Arafat attended a military parade marking Egypt's 1973 war with Israel and were expected to hold brief talks afterwards. Egypt, the region's main political player, has hosted several rounds of peace negotiations.

As the two leaders watched fireworks and listened to a brass band, Palestinian and Israeli negotiators started formal talks in the self-rule Gaza Strip on a long-delayed Israeli troop withdrawal from the West Bank city of Hebron.

Israel, which said earlier it was committed to pulling back its troops, is bargining with the Palestinians for better ways to secure the 400 Jewish settlers living in Hebron which is populated by 100,000 Arabs.
Arafat is due back home early on Tuesday for his first meeting with Israeli President Ezra Weizman.
